section_summary.extract_value: Section 2.3.1 describes the methodology for calculating Body Mass Index (BMI) in the study. Participants' BMI was calculated using the Quetelet Index formula by dividing self-reported current weight in kilograms by self-reported height squared in meters (kg/m²). This indicates that BMI assessment was based on self-reported measurements rather than direct measurement.
